dashboard.label: Help
dashboard.description: Maps+ for Splunk: field reference, Format menu options, integrations, support and credits.
dashboard.definition:
{
  "title": "Help",
  "description": "Maps+ for Splunk: field reference, Format menu options, integrations, support and credits.",
  "dataSources": {},
  "visualizations": {
    "viz_help_01": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "# Maps+ for Splunk

The mapping equivalent of a Swiss Army knife for Splunk.

Use the tabs above to move between topics: **SPL fields** (Markers, Layers & Clusters, Heatmaps & Paths, Drilldown & Overlays), **Integrations**, the **Format menu** reference, then **Help** and **Credits**.",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_02": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Compatibility

Maps+ is compatible with **Splunk 6.4+**. **Splunk 7.0+** is recommended.",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_03": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Usage

Maps+ is driven by the field names in your search results. **Fields must be named exactly as shown. The app keys off field names, not field order.**

```
base_search
| table latitude, longitude
        [ description | tooltip | title | icon | markerColor | markerPriority
        | markerSize | markerAnchor | popupAnchor | markerVisibility | iconColor
        | shadowAnchor | shadowSize | prefix | extraClasses | layerDescription
        | pathWeight | pathOpacity | pathColor | layerGroup | clusterGroup
        | heatmapLayer | heatmapPointIntensity | heatmapMinOpacity | heatmapRadius
        | heatmapBlur | heatmapColorGradient | circleStroke | circleRadius
        | circleColor | circleWeight | circleOpacity | circleFillColor
        | circleFillOpacity | _time ]
```",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_04": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Required Fields

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `latitude` | Latitude coordinates |
| `longitude` | Longitude coordinates |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_05": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Common Optional Fields

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `description` | Shown in a pop-up when the marker is clicked. Get creative: combine other fields or lookups with `eval` to make it full of detail. **Supports HTML.** |
| `layerDescription` | Description added next to the icon in the layer control legend. **Supports HTML.** |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_06": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Where to Find Each Field

| If you want to... | Go to tab |
|---|---|
| Style markers, icons, circles or marker priority | Markers |
| Group markers into layers or cluster groups | Layers & Clusters |
| Draw heatmaps or trace paths | Heatmaps & Paths |
| Enable drilldown, KML/KMZ overlays or measurement | Drilldown & Overlays |
| Google Places, Bing Maps or Street View | Integrations |
| Look up a Format menu option | Format: Core / Format: Features |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_07": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Style Markers and Icons Dynamically Through SPL

Maps+ lets you style map markers and add icons via SPL. Create fields with [eval](http://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/Splunk/6.4.0/SearchReference/CommonEvalFunctions) to define marker colors, or pick an icon from [Font Awesome](http://fortawesome.github.io/Font-Awesome/icons/) or [ionicons](http://ionicons.com/). If the standard color set is too limiting, override the marker icon with a map icon from Font Awesome and style it with any hex color or RGB value.

By default, markers are rendered as **PNGs**. PNG markers come in a limited set of colors and cannot be resized. For an unlimited color palette and resizable markers, use **SVG markers** (see below).",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_08": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## PNG Markers and Icons

| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | Mouse-hover text. **Deprecated** (still works) - use `tooltip`. |  |
| `tooltip` | Tooltip displayed on marker hover. |  |
| `icon` | Icon shown in the marker. Any icon from [Font Awesome](http://fortawesome.github.io/Font-Awesome/icons/) or [ionicons](http://ionicons.com/). | `circle` |
| `markerColor` | Marker color: `red`, `darkred`, `lightred`, `orange`, `beige`, `green`, `darkgreen`, `lightgreen`, `blue`, `darkblue`, `lightblue`, `purple`, `darkpurple`, `pink`, `cadetblue`, `white`, `gray`, `lightgray`, `black`. | `blue` |
| `iconColor` | Icon color. Any [CSS color name](https://www.vogatek.com/html-tutorials/cssref/css_colornames.asp.html), or [hex or RGB value](http://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_picker.asp). | `white` |
| `prefix` | `fa` (Font Awesome) or `ion` (ionicons). | `fa` |
| `extraClasses` | Extra CSS classes for styling. See [additional classes](http://fortawesome.github.io/Font-Awesome/examples/) for Font Awesome / Ionicons. | `fa-lg` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_09": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## SVG Markers

Dynamically size markers and use any color (name or hex). These fields control SVG-based markers.

| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `markerType` | `svg` or `png` | `png` |
| `markerSize` | Comma-separated pixel width and height of the marker. | `35,45` |
| `markerColor` | Any common [HTML color name](http://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_names.asp) or [hex value](http://www.google.com/search?q=html+color+picker). | `#38AADD` |
| `markerAnchor` | Comma-separated coordinates of the "tip" of the icon, relative to its top-left corner. | `15,50` |
| `popupAnchor` | Comma-separated coordinates of the point from which popups open, relative to the icon anchor. |  |
| `shadowSize` | Comma-separated pixel width and height of the shadow. Change only if you change `markerSize`. Use `0,0` to disable shadows. | `30,46` |
| `shadowAnchor` | Comma-separated coordinates of the shadow "tip", relative to its top-left corner. Change only if you change `markerSize`. | `30,30` |
| `iconColor` | Icon color. Any [CSS color name](https://www.vogatek.com/html-tutorials/cssref/css_colornames.asp.html), or [hex or RGB value](http://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_picker.asp). | `white` |
| `prefix` | `fa` (Font Awesome) or `ion` (ionicons). | `fa` |
| `extraClasses` | Extra CSS classes for styling. See [additional classes](http://fortawesome.github.io/Font-Awesome/examples/) for Font Awesome. |  |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_10": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Circle Markers

Use circle markers when you have a lot of points to plot and need performance. They render on canvas instead of SVG, which is a big performance win, and are highly customizable.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `circleRadius` | Radius of the circle marker, in pixels. |
| `circleColor` | Stroke color. |
| `circleFillColor` | Fill color. Defaults to the value of `circleColor`. |
| `circleOpacity` | Stroke opacity. |
| `circleFillOpacity` | Fill opacity. |
| `circleStroke` | Whether to draw a stroke. Set to `false` to disable borders. |
| `circleWeight` | Stroke width, in pixels. |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_11": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Marker Priority

Higher-priority markers render on top of lower-priority ones. This is especially useful on dense maps where certain markers must stand out.

| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `markerPriority` | Number that sets marker priority. Higher values render over lower values. Use a high value like `1000` (or a large negative value to render beneath). | `0` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_12": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Layer Controls

Group marker and icon styles into their own layer. A layer control widget (enabled by default, optionally hidden) appears in the upper right of the map. It shows a legend for each icon class with a check-box to toggle those markers on or off. It works for both clustered and stand-alone markers.

By default markers are grouped by icon. If you have the same icon in different colors, use `layerGroup` to split them into their own groups for filtering.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `layerGroup` | Unique group the marker belongs to. |
| `layerDescription` | Description text shown next to each icon in the layer control legend. |

Related Format menu options (Layer Controls) are on the **Format: Core** tab.",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_13": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Cluster Groups

By default all markers render into a single cluster group. Override this with the `clusterGroup` SPL field. See the **Multi-Cluster Groups** example dashboard in the app for details.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `clusterGroup` | Name of the cluster group the marker belongs to. |
| `clusterBgColor` | Per-row field. Sets the **outer ring** color of the cluster icon for this row's `clusterGroup`. Accepts hex, `rgba()` and named CSS colors. Takes priority over the **Cluster Group Colors** formatter option. If only `clusterBgColor` is provided, `clusterFgColor` mirrors it. |
| `clusterFgColor` | Per-row field. Sets the **inner circle** color of the cluster icon for this row's `clusterGroup`. Accepts hex, `rgba()` and named CSS colors. Takes priority over the **Cluster Group Colors** formatter option. |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_14": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Heatmaps

Render heatmaps with or without markers. Control them from the Format menu (**Format: Features** tab) or directly with SPL. Create multiple heatmap layers with the `heatmapLayer` field.

When controlling heatmaps through SPL, the **first event** for a given `heatmapLayer` defines that layer's settings (`heatmapMinOpacity`, `heatmapMaxZoom`, `heatmapRadius`, `heatmapBlur`, `heatmapColorGradient`). If not specified, values from the Format menu are used.

| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `heatmapLayer` | Name of the heatmap layer to render. |  |
| `heatmapPointIntensity` | Intensity of the point. | `1.0` |
| `heatmapMinOpacity` | Minimum opacity the heat starts at. |  |
| `heatmapRadius` | Radius of each heatmap "point". | `25` |
| `heatmapBlur` | Amount of blur. | `15` |
| `heatmapColorGradient` | Color gradient config. | `{"0.4":"blue","0.6":"cyan","0.7":"lime","0.8":"yellow","1":"red"}` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_15": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Path Tracing

If your dataset has multiple coordinates per object (cars, trains, planes, bicycles - anything that moves and can be tracked) you can trace its path on the map. Control whether markers show along the path with `markerVisibility`.

Show split intervals by enabling **Path Splits** and adjusting **Path Split Interval** in the Format menu (**Format: Features** tab). `_time` must be present for split intervals to work.

| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `markerVisibility` | Show a marker for the given coordinates. Set to `marker` to show, any other value to hide. |  |
| `pathWeight` | Weight (width) of the path. | `5` |
| `pathOpacity` | Opacity of the path line. | `0.5` |
| `pathColor` | Color of the path. If not specified, chosen randomly from the **Path Colors** option. |  |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_16": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Drilldown

The visualization identifies any non-standard fields and makes them available as drilldown fields. Add any fields you want to the final `table` command and you can use them via drilldown in Simple XML.

References: [dynamic drilldown](http://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/Splunk/6.5.1/Viz/Dynamicdrilldownindashboardsandforms) and [accessing tokens for dynamic drilldown](http://docs.splunk.com/Documentation/Splunk/latest/Viz/tokens#Define_tokens_for_dynamic_drilldown).

### How to use it

Drilldown is **disabled by default**. Enable it in the **Map** section of the Format menu, then **double-click** a marker to activate the drilldown behavior.",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_17": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Measurement Plugin

Interactively measure paths and areas on the map. Enabled by default.

1. Click the icon in the upper right corner of the map.
2. Select **Create new measurement**.
3. Draw a simple path, or click to define multiple points to measure an area.

Measurements are **not persisted**. This is an interactive tool for a single session.

Units, colors and position are configured on the **Format: Features** tab.",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_18": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## KML / KMZ Overlays

Add custom overlays to the map. If you have existing KML or KMZ files that define features (polylines, polygons, etc.) you can overlay them on the map.

**1. Copy your KML/KMZ files into this directory:**

```
$SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/leaflet_maps_app/appserver/static/visualizations/maps-plus/contrib/kml
```

**2.** Click **Format** and select the **Overlays** tab. Enter a comma-separated list of the filenames you copied. File order sets feature layering: `file1.kml` renders beneath `file2.kmz`.

```
file1.kml,file2.kmz
```

Files are loaded asynchronously when the map renders. Overlay changes require a browser refresh.",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_19": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Google Places Search

A search control for the Google Places API.

1. Log into the [Google API Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/), enable the `Google Places API Web Service` and `Google Maps JavaScript API` for your project, and create an API key. See [Google's docs](https://developers.google.com/places/web-service/get-api-key?authuser=2) for detailed instructions.
2. Enable the control: `Google Places -> Google Places Search -> Enabled`
3. Set the API key: `Google Places -> API Key`
4. Optional: set the fly-to zoom with `Google Places -> Zoom Level`",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_20": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Bing Maps

A Bing Maps tile layer.

1. Enable or disable it: `Bing Maps -> Bing Maps -> Enabled`. While Bing Maps is enabled, the default tile layer set and the map attribution override do **not** work.
2. Paste your Bing Maps API key into `Bing Maps -> API Key`.
3. Choose the imagery in `Bing Maps -> Tile Layer`.
4. Optional: localize tile labels with `Bing Maps -> Label Language`. See [Microsoft's documentation](https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/hh441729.aspx).",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_21": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Google Street View Companion Visualization

Maps+ bundles a Google Street View visualization. Use it as a drilldown target when clicking a marker. See the **Google Street View Drilldown** example dashboard in the app for detailed usage.

### Pre-requisites

Street View needs an API key. Log in to the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/), enable the `Maps JavaScript API` and `Street View API`, and [generate an API key](https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/api-keys).",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_22": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Street View Fields and Options

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `coordinates` | **Required.** Comma-separated pair in the format `<latitude>,<longitude>`, e.g. `| eval coordinates=latitude.",".longitude` |

| Format option | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| API Key | Google Street View API key. |  |
| Default Height | Initial height of the map. | `600` |
| Full Screen Mode | Enable or disable full screen mode. The map takes all available space in the browser and adjusts on resize. |  |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_23": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Map

| Option | Description | Default | Refresh |
|---|---|---|---|
| Map Tile | Select one of six available map tiles. |  |  |
| Map Tile Override | Use your own map tile URL. Example: `http://a.tiles.wmflabs.org/hikebike/{z}/{x}/{y}.png`. Find more tiles [here](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tiles). |  |  |
| Map Attribution Override | Use your own attribution. |  | Yes |
| Renderer | Use the Canvas renderer for a performance boost drawing vector layers (path, circle). Requires a modern browser with Canvas support. |  |  |
| Progress Indicator | Display a progress spinner for long-running searches. |  |  |
| Scroll Wheel Zoom | Enable or disable scroll wheel zoom. |  |  |
| Full Screen Mode | Map takes all available space in the browser and adjusts on resize. |  | Yes |
| Drilldown | Enable or disable drilldown. Double-click a marker to activate. |  | Yes |
| Context Menu | Enable or disable the context menu when right-clicking the map. |  |  |
| Default Height | Initial height of the map. | `600` |  |
| Auto Fit & Zoom | When the search finishes, set the map view to contain all markers at the maximum possible zoom. | `Enabled` |  |
| Auto Fit & Zoom Delay (ms) | Delay before triggering Auto Fit & Zoom. Increase if behavior is inconsistent. | `500` |  |
| Dashboard Refresh Interval | Delay in seconds before refreshing the dashboard. **WARNING:** forces a full browser refresh of the entire dashboard (works around the Custom Viz API not reliably honoring panel or global Simple XML refresh). `0` = disabled. | `0` |  |
| Map Zoom | Initial zoom for the map. | `6` |  |
| Center Lat | Initial center latitude. | `39.50` |  |
| Center Lon | Initial center longitude. | `-98.35` |  |
| Min Zoom | Minimum zoom for the tile layer. Does not affect map zoom. | `1` |  |
| Max Zoom | Maximum zoom for the tile layer. Does not affect map zoom. | `19` |  |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_24": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Clustering

| Option | Description | Default | Refresh |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enable Clustering | Disable to plot all markers unclustered. **WARNING:** significant performance penalty on large datasets. |  | Yes |
| Show All Popups | Display all popups on page load. Only works with clustering disabled. |  | Yes |
| Allow Multiple Popups | Allow multiple popups on screen without closing the previous one. Disappear at higher zoom levels with clustering enabled. Enabled by default when showing all popups. |  | Yes |
| Animate | Animate cluster separation on zoom. |  | Yes |
| Single Marker Mode | Re-style single marker icons to the round marker cluster style. |  | Yes |
| Disable Clustering At Zoom | Turns on the zoom threshold below. Must be Enabled for the level setting to apply. |  |  |
| Disable Clustering At Zoom Level | At this zoom level and below, markers are not clustered. Requires *Disable Clustering At Zoom* to be Enabled. |  |  |
| Max Cluster Radius | A cluster covers at most this many pixels from its center. | `80` | Yes |
| Cluster Warning Size | Show a warning that the cluster exceeds the threshold at max zoom and hide the underlying markers. The browser may hang if a single point exceeds a very large number. | `100` | Yes |
| Distance Multiplier | Increase to push markers further from the center when expanded at max zoom. | `1` | Yes |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_25": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Markers

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| Permanent Tooltip | Open the tooltip permanently, or only on mouseover. Depends on the `tooltip` field in search results. |
| Sticky Tooltip | Tooltip follows the mouse instead of a fixed position. |

## Layer Controls

Changes require a browser refresh.

| Option | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Layer Control | Enable or disable dynamic filtering of layer groups. Each icon type's visibility is toggled from the control in the upper right of the map. | `Enabled` |
| Control Collapsed | Collapse or expand the layer control. If collapsed, mousing over the icon expands it. | `Collapsed` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_26": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Cluster Colors

Changes require a browser refresh.

| Option | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Range One Background |  | `#B5E28C` |
| Range One Foreground |  | `#6ECC39` |
| Range Two Threshold | Number at which cluster group two starts. |  |
| Range Two Background |  | `#F1D357` |
| Range Two Foreground |  | `#F0C20C` |
| Range Three Threshold | Number at which cluster group three starts. |  |
| Range Three Background |  | `#FD9C73` |
| Range Three Foreground |  | `#F18017` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_27": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Heatmap

| Option | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Enable Heatmap | Enable or disable the heatmap. |  |
| Heatmap Only | Show only the heatmap. No markers are rendered. |  |
| Min Opacity | Minimum opacity the heat starts at. | `1.0` |
| Max Zoom | Zoom level where points reach maximum intensity. | Max Zoom of map |
| Radius | Max point intensity. | `1.0` |
| Blur | Amount of blur. | `15` |
| Color Gradient | Color gradient config. | `{"0.4":"blue","0.6":"cyan","0.7":"lime","0.8":"yellow","1":"red"}` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_28": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Path Lines

| Option | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Path Lines | Draw path lines for markers that have multiple coordinates. |  |
| Renderer | Use the Canvas renderer for a performance boost drawing paths. Requires a modern browser with Canvas support. |  |
| Path Identifier | Field that distinguishes unique paths, e.g. vehicle number or trip ID. |  |
| Path Colors | Comma-separated hex or HTML colors for path lines (wraps around if there are more paths than colors). |  |
| Path Splits | Split a path into segments based on the time gap between points. `_time` must be present in results. |  |
| Path Split Interval | Seconds by which path segments are defined. Higher values give a more continuous path; lower values give more segments and gaps. | `60` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_29": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Measure

| Option | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Enable Measurement Plugin | Enable or disable path and area measurement on the map. | `Enabled` |
| Localization | Language. | `English` |
| Icon Position | Position of the measurement icon on the map. | `Top Right` |
| Primary Length Unit | Primary unit for length measurement. | `feet` |
| Secondary Length Unit | Secondary unit for length measurement. | `miles` |
| Primary Area Unit | Primary unit for area measurement. | `acres` |
| Secondary Area Unit | Secondary unit for area measurement. | `square miles` |
| Active Color | Color of the measurement while drawing. | `#00ff00` |
| Completed Color | Color of the measurement once drawing is complete. | `#0066ff` |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_30": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Google Places

| Option | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Google Places Search | Enable or disable the Google Places API search control. |  |
| API Key | Google Places API key. |  |
| Search Bar Position | Position of the search bar. | `Top Left` |
| Zoom Level | Zoom level to fly to. |  |

## Bing Maps

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| Bing Maps | Enable or disable Bing Maps tiles. |
| API Key | Bing Maps API key. |
| Tile Layer | Select the tile layer imagery set. |
| Label Language | Select the language used for labels. |

## Overlays

Changes require a browser refresh.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| KML/KMZ Overlay | Comma-separated list of KML or KMZ file names copied into the app's `kml` directory (`file1.kml, file2.kml`). |",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_31": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Support

This app is supported by Scott Haskell ([shaskell@splunk.com](mailto:shaskell@splunk.com)).

Code is hosted on GitHub: [sghaskell/maps-plus](https://github.com/sghaskell/maps-plus)",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_32": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Quick Tips

- Open the **Examples** menu in the app navigation for working dashboards you can copy from.
- Field names are case-sensitive and must match exactly. Field order does not matter.
- Only `latitude` and `longitude` are required. Everything else is optional.
- Options marked **Refresh** on the Format tabs need a browser refresh before they take effect.
- Add extra fields to your final `table` command to make them available for drilldown.",
        "fontSize": "default"
      }
    },
    "viz_help_33": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "## Leaflet and Plugins

- [Leaflet Maps](http://leafletjs.com/)
- [Leaflet Markercluster Plugin](https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster)
- [Leaflet Awesome Markers Plugin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/drmonty-leaflet-awesome-markers)
- [Leaflet.vector-markers Plugin](https://github.com/hiasinho/Leaflet.vector-markers)
- [Leaflet.FeatureGroup.SubGroup](https://github.com/ghybs/Leaflet.FeatureGroup.SubGroup)
